author: Runic Artifex
name: Runic View
description: Adds a Runic View, or a Window, and its C# ViewModel to an existing project that references a Runic host or Runic.Application.Views. The build generates its typed TypeScript client.

viewModels.description: The MVVM library of the project's ViewModels.

window.description: Declares a Window, which a host opens with OpenWindowAsync, instead of a View, which a Window or another View shows.

namespace.description: The namespace of the generated types. Default: the RootNamespace of the project in the current directory once it has been restored, otherwise App.

postActions.description: Explains how to use the new ViewModel.

manualInstructions.text: Register the ViewModel where the application registers its services, for example services.AddScoped<NameViewModel>(). AddRunicViews() registers the View. Show a View from a property of a Window or View ViewModel, or open a Window with host.OpenWindowAsync<NameWindow>(). The next build writes its typed client to the frontend's src/generated folder.
